controlledBrowsers.consolidation: For each engine take the eight passing v1 check names plus only the corrected episode scenario from v3. Repeated setup and selection checks in v2/v3 are not added.
controlledBrowsers.countScope: Nine unique checks per engine, including two setup checks and seven media scenarios; not 27 distinct product features.

observerHistory.reason: A visitor session bootstrap search with the exact stored video ID was incorrectly labelled musical matching. Raw failures remain unchanged.

An offline restored PodcastView attempted its known metadata browse. The broad no-nonmedia assertion rejected this aborted metadata request after successful local playback/seek/checkpoint operations. Raw failures remain unchanged.

Only the exact known no-params WEB visitor bootstrap and known failed offline metadata browse are distinguished. Player/source/musical searches remain forbidden offline; external provider deliveries remain zero.

controlledBrowsers.scope: Compiled Svelte UI, genuine ninety-second silent AAC fixture, native decoder, IDB, CacheStorage and production service worker. Desktop layouts; no real musical recording, physical mobile, background transfer or long-episode claim.
controlledBrowsers.outageScope: Each final episode scenario records its actual outage mode and navigator.onLine expectation. WebKit HTTP origin/provider outage is not presented as physical airplane mode.

negativeControl.meaning: Six expected capability/repair failures on frozen pre-feature product modules; three unchanged-policy controls pass. Not failures of the released product.

initialSetupFailure.reason: Configured Chrome executable absent before launch.

update.scope: Compiled final graph with real worker, IDB/cache fixtures and duplicate playlists; no physical icon/APK-data migration or live extraction claim.

priorPendingVerification.reason: HTTP verification was attempted before the deployment workflow finished. Its mixed-version/absent-file result remains a historical failure, superseded by the final exact-build33/33 check.

sourceBindingPolicy: Historical mutable source paths describe execution-time bytes. Each immutable QA snapshot is bound separately; the final observer does not rewrite earlier reports or results.
